yolo_detector.training: 50 epochs, imgsz 640 (default), ultralytics default geometric/color augmentation, seeds 42/43/44, patient-level split 293/94/99 (train/val/test)
yolo_detector.operating_point: conf >= 0.25 (ultralytics default, fixed at registration); threshold-sensitivity analysis (tau 0.10/0.15/0.25) shows the failure is detection absence, not threshold placement

p4_tta.optimizer: Ultralytics 8.3.108 defaults (SGD momentum 0.937, weight decay 5e-4) with lr0 = 1e-3 (10x below default)
p4_tta.frozen_layers: none - full fine-tune from the current weights
p4_tta.augmentation: registered defaults + per-image p=0.8 draw of 1+ of six domain ops: console text, fan vignette, gamma/contrast, vertical shadow, speckle, cutout (parameters in scripts/m5_tta_aug.py)
p4_tta.pseudo_labels: top-1 box per slice at conf >= 0.50; slices without a detection excluded from training (neither positive nor negative)
